title: tc-image-generation
description: One image while it's generated: queued, a picture that sharpens as it progresses with the step and time left, then the image – or why it failed.

heading.description: Names the card – what the image is for

position.description: The image's place in the queue while queued – 1 is next

progress.description: How far along it is, 0 to 1, while generating; left out, the bar sweeps

step.description: The step the model is on, while generating

steps.description: How many steps the job takes

eta.description: Seconds left, when the model estimates it

phase.description: What it's doing while generating, in a word – "Generating", "Refining", "Upscaling"

src.description: The finished image's URL – a data: URL works too. Shown when done

alt.description: What the finished image shows, for people who can't see it

preview.description: An intermediate image the model sent, shown blurred while generating – the blur falls as the progress rises

error.description: Why it failed, in a few words

prompt.description: The prompt the image comes from

model.description: The model's name, shown as a chip under the prompt

size.description: The image's size, shown as a chip – "1024 × 1536"

aspectRatio.description: The frame's shape, so nothing jumps when the image arrives: "1:1", "16:9", "3:4" …

filename.description: File name for Download – from the heading by default

expanded.description: Whether a long prompt shows in full

labels.description: Rename any of the words, over the defaults
